review.notes: All 35 physical pages diffed against the OCR markdown with hyphenation-aware word/prose windows; physical pages 17, 31, 32, 33 rendered at 110 dpi and the Example 2 Part 2 think chunk re-verified at 300 dpi. No unbalanced code fences exist in this source. Remaining diff deltas are LaTeX-equivalent math, figure-internal diagram labels, table headers/cells already present in the OCR tables, and the checklist guideline boilerplate that is present in the OCR. The NeurIPS checklist Answer/Guidelines labels and the demo-transcript labels (Think, Model's Response) are plain text in the source; three spurious level-2 headings were demoted and the two dropped Example 1 demo banners restored as headings to match the Example 2 treatment. The appendix-G demo systematically normalizes the deliberately misspelled query word strawberrry (three r's, verified on renders) to strawberry, and drops one whole think chunk on physical p.33; both repaired. The md's duplicated/out-of-order emission of the Example 2 Part 1 think body (early, after Example 1 Part 1) cannot be repaired by exact string replacement and is left unresolved.
